name: 达西-魏斯巴赫沿程损失计算器

map.由摩擦系数、管长、管径、密度与流速，按 ΔP = f(L/D)(ρv²/2) 计: Compute pipe friction pressure drop by dP = f(L/D)(rho v^2/2) from friction factor, pipe length and diameter, fluid density and velocity.
map.f 可用 Moody 图或 Colebrook 公式由 Re 与相对粗糙度求得。: f is found from Re and relative roughness via the Moody chart or Colebrook equation.
map.不同 f、L、D、v 敏感性分析。: Sensitivity to f, L, D, v.
map.泵扬程中沿程部分核算。: Check the friction part within pump head.
map.D 0.1→0.2，同 v 时 h_f 减半到 0.51 m，扩径降损显著。: D 0.1→0.2; at same v, h_f halves to 0.51 m — enlarging diameter cuts loss sharply.
map.层流 f=64/Re，紊流依赖 Re 与相对粗糙度，穆迪图查取。: Laminar f=64/Re; turbulent depends on Re and relative roughness, read from the Moody chart.
map.达西通用；海曾-威廉用于给水塑料/金属管经验式，参数 C 不同。: Darcy is general; Hazen-Williams is an empirical formula for water-supply plastic/metal pipes with a different parameter C.
map.达西沿程损失（本页代码口径，先算压降再折水头）：ΔP = f×(L÷D)×(ρ×: Darcy friction loss (page code basis; pressure drop first, then converted to head): ΔP = f×(L÷D)×(ρ×v²÷2) (Pa); head loss h = ΔP÷(ρ×9.81) (m). Validation: five inputs are guarded against empty values, which trigger a prompt; a zero diameter is shown as «—» to avoid division by zero. Verdict: no fixed grading; h is proportional to pipe length and to the square of velocity and inversely proportional to diameter (equivalent to h_f = f·(L/D)·v²÷2g).
